The definition itself is sound: its formula is H(C intersect (Theta x A_epsilon))/Z_epsilon, a normalized measurable-event restriction of the supplied probability H when Z_epsilon>0. The lemma depends on the definition as SCHEMA permits for discharges; this is not a circular deps argument. Removed only the unsupported justified_by entry; Definition and marginal reference are unchanged.

For any fixed admissible x0 the vertical line {x0} x X is null for both atomless flows. Valid density representatives can therefore set f=1,g=0 there and make acceptance zero (or f=0,g=1 and make it one). Equality of flows does not license the original pointwise conclusion. The repair explicitly chooses f=h(x)/(h(x)+h(y)), g=h(y)/(h(x)+h(y)), with f=g=1/2 where both indicators vanish. Both proposal probabilities are positive, so domination holds for every previous population; the conditioned (0,0) population occurs with probability 1/4.
